name: estate-door-side-verify
description: ESTATE-DOOR-SIDE: the common corridor must front the plan's REAL main door, on any of the four exterior faces. The two HDB templates whose main door is NOT on +z: tpl-hdb-5room (door on the -z face) and tpl-hdb-3gen (door on the +x face). For each: an orbit frame (corridor slab visible on the door side, window facade opposite) and two walk frames — standing at the main door looking OUT through it, and at the window on the face opposite the corridor. Run with SHOT_GPU=1.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: 5room-probe
steps.eval: (() => { let g = null; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name === 'estate-surround') g = o }); const c = g && g.getObjectByName('own-corridor-floor'); if (c) c.updateWorldMatrix(true, false); const e = c && c.matrixWorld.elements; const p = e && { x: e[12], z: e[14] }; console.log('[probe] 5room estate', JSON.stringify({ group: !!g, yawDeg: g ? Math.round(g.rotation.y * 180 / Math.PI) : null, offset: g ? [g.position.x, g.position.z] : null, corridorWorld: p ? [Math.round(p.x * 100) / 100, Math.round(p.z * 100) / 100] : null })) })()

steps.name: 5room-pose-door
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(7.55, 1.9); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.03) })()

steps.name: 5room-pose-window
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(2.6, 1.6); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.02) })()

steps.name: 3gen-probe
steps.eval: (() => { let g = null; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name === 'estate-surround') g = o }); const c = g && g.getObjectByName('own-corridor-floor'); if (c) c.updateWorldMatrix(true, false); const e = c && c.matrixWorld.elements; const p = e && { x: e[12], z: e[14] }; console.log('[probe] 3gen estate', JSON.stringify({ group: !!g, yawDeg: g ? Math.round(g.rotation.y * 180 / Math.PI) : null, offset: g ? [g.position.x, g.position.z] : null, corridorWorld: p ? [Math.round(p.x * 100) / 100, Math.round(p.z * 100) / 100] : null })) })()

steps.name: 3gen-pose-door
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(8.8, 1.55); l.setYaw(-Math.PI / 2); l.setPitch(-0.03) })()

steps.name: 3gen-pose-window
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(1.7, 4.6); l.setYaw(Math.PI / 2); l.setPitch(-0.02) })()
